headline: UK Chancellor John Healey Prepares Cautious Budget to Reassure Bond Markets
summary: British Chancellor of the Exchequer John Healey is preparing to deliver a restrained budget aimed at avoiding renewed volatility in domestic gilt markets while steering the national economy.
why: UK government fiscal statements have a direct bearing on gilt yields, sterling exchange rates, and sovereign debt borrowing costs.

impacts.name: UK Gilts
impacts.why: A cautious fiscal stance seeks to limit supply pressure on UK sovereign debt.
